title: fix: stop fingerprint prompt loop, make biometric unlock work offline, add enable/disable setting
body:
## Summary

Fixes the repeating fingerprint prompt (offline and intermittently online) and adds a Settings toggle to enable/disable biometric unlock.

Two root causes in `login_screen.dart`:

1. **Prompt loop.** `authenticate()` ran with default options, where `persistAcrossBackgrounding` is `false`. On Android the system BiometricPrompt is cancelled whenever the activity is briefly paused (fingerprint overlay, a notification, or the OS recreating the activity); the awaited future then completes/throws and the prompt is re-shown — "asks again and again until I kill the app". There was also no guard against starting a second prompt while one was in flight.
2. **Offline.** After a successful fingerprint it always called `signInWithPassword`, which needs the network. Offline that fails and dumps the user back on the login screen re-trying the fingerprint forever.

Changes:
- New `lib/src/features/auth/biometric_auth.dart`:
  - `BiometricAuthService` wraps `LocalAuthentication` and always uses `persistAcrossBackgrounding: true` (local_auth 3.x's replacement for `stickyAuth`) so the prompt survives lifecycle pauses instead of being cancelled/re-shown.
  - `biometricEnabledProvider` (`StateNotifier<bool>`) persists the user's choice in `SharedPreferences` (`biometric_enabled`).
  - `hasSavedCredentials()` helper.
- `login_screen.dart`:
  - `_isAuthenticating` re-entrancy guard so a prompt can't stack/loop.
  - Offline-aware unlock — pseudocode:
    ```
    if (authenticated) {
      if (currentSession != null) -> go(Dashboard)        // works offline via cached data
      else if (offline)           -> show "you're offline" // no more failing network sign-in
      else                        -> replay saved creds via _login()
    }
    ```
  - Biometric button now only shows when the device supports it AND saved creds exist AND the setting is enabled. Button label/messages are localized.
- `settings_screen.dart`: new `_BiometricSettingTile` (`SwitchListTile`) under Offline mode, shown only with Supabase auth; requires a successful biometric check to turn on; disabled when the device has no biometrics.
- `app_localizations.dart`: new keys for biometric button + settings, localized in EN/FR/AR/IT (covered by the existing "all required keys for all languages" test).
- `test/biometric_auth_test.dart`: unit tests for the preference notifier and `hasSavedCredentials`.

## Verification

- [x] `flutter analyze` — No issues found
- [x] `flutter test` — `+122 -3`; the 3 failures (navigation role restrictions / mobile more menu) are **pre-existing on `main`** (identical `+122 -3` with my changes stashed) and unrelated to this change. New `biometric_auth_test.dart` passes (6/6).
- [ ] `flutter build web`
- [ ] `flutter build apk --debug` when Android/resources/build config changed

## Supabase

- [x] No Supabase changes

- [ ] Docs updated when setup, deployment, or operations changed
